p: judge: Are you ready to execute your charge, which I commit to you against Jerusalem that murders the prophets and them that are godly?
time may come: That is, the time of her destruction.
herself to defile herself: To her own undoing.
infamous and much troubled: Whose very name all men hate.
have they dealt by oppression with: He means by this that there was no kind of wickedness which was not committed in Jerusalem and therefore the plagues of God would speedily come on her.
smitten my hand at thy dishonest: In token of my wrath and vengeance.
be strong: That is, able to defend yourself.
filthiness out of thee: I will thus take away the occasion of your wickedness.
inheritance in thyself in the sight: You will be no more the inheritance of the Lord, but forsaken.
dross: Which before was most precious.
and melt you: Meaning by this that the godly would be tried and the wicked destroyed.
nor rained upon in the day: You are like a barren land which the Lord plagues with drought.
of her prophets in the midst: The false prophets have conspired together to make their doctrine more probable.
eyes from my sabbaths: They have neglected my service.
prophets have daubed them with untempered: They who would have reproved them, flattered them in their vices and covered their doings with lies. See Geneva "Eze 13:10"
make up the hedge: Who would show himself zealous in my cause by resisting vice, Isa 59:16 also pray to me to withhold my plagues, Ps 106:23.
